question: Where was the newly developed Mahseer Hatchery and Freshwater Ichthyology and Sustainable Aquaculture Laboratory inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur University.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A newly developed Mahseer Hatchery and Freshwater Ichthyology and Sustainable Aquaculture Laboratory was inaugurated at the Department of Zoology, Manipur University.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The laboratory was jointly developed by ICAR-Central Institute of Coldwater Fisheries Research, Bhimtal, Uttarakhand, and Manipur University.**
 
• **It aims to strengthen the fisheries sector in Manipur by promoting sustainable aquaculture practices.**
 
• **Manipur has abundant water bodies like ponds, rivers, and lakes, making it suitable for fisheries growth.**
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports fisheries development under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mahseer Hatchery__

 __
 
• Mahseer is a freshwater fish species, known for its high economic and ecological value.
 
• The hatchery focuses on breeding and conserving Mahseer species to support fisheries and biodiversity.
 
 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)__
 __
 
• A government initiative to enhance fish production, double farmers’ income, and improve infrastructure in the fisheries sector.
 
• It supports sustainable aquaculture, fish processing, and market linkages.
 
 
 
• Fisheries Sector in Manipur__
 
 
• Manipur has significant potential for fisheries due to its natural water resources.
 
• The new laboratory will help boost fish farming, research, and conservation efforts in the state.
